senses.gloss:
शस् श॑सति शस्ति & शास्ति pp. शस्त cut to pieces,
slaughter. — वि = S.

ष॑ष् pl. (nom. ष॑ट्) six;
 ष॑ट् also as adv. six times.

सस् स॑स्ति स॑सस्ति सस॑स्ति slumber, be lazy or
slothful.
शश॑ m. hare (seen also in the spot of the moon).
शाश a. relating to a hare, leporine.
शाशक a. relating to a hare, leporine.
शशकविषाण n. a hare's horn ( = impossibility).
शशबिन्दु m. N. of a prince.
शशमान॑ a. active, busy, zealous, devout, pious.
शशयु॑ a. desiring or pursuing hares.

शशलक्ष्मन् n. the hare-mark;
 m. = prec.

सशङ्क a. afraid, timid;
 n. adv.

शशाङ्कलेखा f. the lunar crescent (lit.
moon-streak).
शशिकला f. a digit or sickle of the moon.
शासिन् a. punishing, instructing, commanding, ruling (—˚).

शशिसंनिभ^1 a. = शशिप्रभ.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: alph. order, cf. mw.

शष्कुलि f. the orifice of the ear or auditory passage;
also a kind of food or meal.

शष्कु˚ली f. the orifice of the ear or auditory passage;
also a kind of food or meal.
श॑सन n. श॑सा f. slaughter, killing.

शा॑सन a. (f. ई) & n. chastising, punishing,
instructing, teaching;
 n. also chastisement, punishment, discipline,
government, order, command, edict, precept. — शासनं कृ, ˚ने वृत् or
स्था obey the orders of (gen. or —˚).
2 शस्त a. cut to pieces, slaughtered.
3 शस्त n. a kind of girdle.
1 शस्त्र॑ n. a kind of recitation ((r.)).

2 श॑स्त्र n. knife, dagger (also f. शस्त्री & शस्त्रिका);
sword, weapon i.g.

शास्त्र॑ n. instruction, precept, rule, theory, a scientific
or canonical work.
शस्त्रन्यास m. the laying down of arms.
शस्त्रपत्त्र n. blade of a knife or sword.

शस्त्रपाणि^1 a. having a sword in hand.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: Sense is Sastra,.

शस्त्र˚पाणिन्^1 a. having a sword in hand.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: variant of SastrapARi.
शस्त्रपात m. the (fall or) cut of a knife.
शस्त्रप्रहार m. the stroke of a sword.

शस्त्रभृत् a. bearing a sword;
 m. warrior.
शस्त्रवन्त् a. armed with a sword.
शस्त्रवृत्ति a. living by the trade of arms.
शस्त्रसंपात m. flying or discharge of missiles.

सस्त्रीक a. along with the wife or having a wife,
married.

शास्त्रिन् a. learned;
 m. a scholar or learned man.

श॑स्य a. to be recited or praised;
 n. recitation.
शा॑स्य a. to be punished, directed, or ruled.
शासनधर m. messenger, envoy (bearer of commands).
शासनीय a. to be taught or instructed.
शासहस्त a. holding a knife in the hand.
शासितृ m. chastiser, punisher, governor, teacher.
शासितव्य a. to be taught or prescribed.

शास्त्रकार m. the author of a Śāstra work (cf.
prec.).
शास्त्र˚कृत् m. the author of a Śāstra work (cf. prec.).
शास्त्रतस् adv. according to precept or law.

शास्त्रदृष्ट a. mentioned or stated in a Śāstra work,
according to precept or rule.

शास्त्रमति a. having a learned mind;
 m. a scholar.
शास्त्रवाद m. statement of the Śāstras.
षष्टिक n. the number sixty, sixty.
षष्टिधा adv. in sixty ways or parts.
2 षष्ठभक्त a. eating only the sixth repast.

षष्ठांशवृत्ति a. living on the sixth part (king;
cf. षड्भाग).
सशयन f. ई lying together, neighbouring.

सशर a. furnished with an arrow (bow) or along with the
arrow.

सशरचापहस्त a. holding a bow with an arrow in
the hand.
सशल्य a. wounded or tormented (by an arrow-point).

सशेष a. having or leaving a rest, not quite emptied or
finished.

सशोक a. afflicted, sad;
 n. adv.

सश्च् स॑श्चति v. सच्;
 pp. सश्च॑त् pursuer, enemy.
ससखीका f. along with the (female) friends.
ससखीजना f. along with the (female) friends.
ससंकेत a. privy to a mystery.
ससत्त्रि॑न् m. companion at a festival.
स॑सत्त्रिन् m. companion at a festival.
ससंध्य a. along with the morning twilight.
ससंध्याश a. along with the evening twilight.
ससभ्य a. with the assessor or judges.

ससंभ्रम a. excited, agitated;
 n. adv.
ससहाय a. along with companions or accomplices.

ससाक्षिक a. having or before witnesses;
 n. adv.
ससागर a. with the seas (the earth).

ससाध्वीक a. along with Arundhātī (lit. the good
wife).

ससितोत्पलमालिन् a. crowned with white
lotus-flowers.
ससुत a. with the sons or children.
ससुवर्ण a. with gold, dressed in gold.

स॑सोम a. with Soma;
 abstr. ˚त्व† n.
स॑स्थूण a. along with the pillar.

सस्नेह a. oily, greasy;
 affectionate, tender.

सस्पृह a. desiring, longing for (loc. or infin.);
 n. adv.
सस्यपाल m. watcher of the standing crop.
सस्यान्ते (loc.) when the grain is at an end.
सस्वाहाकार a. accompanied by the sound Svāhā.
साशंसम् adv. with the expression of desire or hope.

साश्रु a. tearful, weeping;
 n. adv.

साष्टाङ्ग a. made with eight members (bow);
 reverential.
n. & ˚पातम् adv. (lit. by falling down with eight members)
reverentially, humbly.

सासूय a. impatient, angry;
 n. adv.
